wiki.title: Wiki & Help
wiki.description: Quick guidance for editor workflows, shortcuts, safety features and accessibility inside the app.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Welcome to the SimNexus / ETS2 Save Edit Tool. This wiki explains the main areas, shortcuts and features directly inside the app.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.esc: Close open modals or windows when possible.

save_editor.title: Save Edit Tool
save_editor.item_truck: Edit truck values such as wear, fuel, mileage and identity fields.
save_editor.item_trailer: Edit trailer values such as condition, cargo mass and trailer identity data.
save_editor.item_profile: Edit profile values such as money, XP, level and related progress data.
save_editor.item_validate: Review values before writing changes to the active save.
save_editor.item_backup: When backup and restore workflows are available, use them before applying risky changes.

career.title: Career Mode / VTC
career.item_dispatcher: Dispatcher workflows help coordinate job generation, assignment and routing decisions.
career.item_jobs: Jobs, offers, active contracts and history provide operational visibility for current and past work.
career.item_company: The company profile area covers company identity, visibility and organization settings.
career.item_members: Members and roles define access, responsibilities and company participation.
career.item_fleet: Fleet panels summarize trucks, assignments, readiness and maintenance state.
career.item_stats: Balance, statistics and achievements help track long-term company progress.

health.title: Save Health Monitor
health.item_status: Save health can report states such as Clean, Risky or Broken.
health.item_mods: Missing mods can lead to incomplete loads or unstable save behavior.
health.item_refs: Broken references indicate objects or links that can no longer be resolved safely.
health.item_xp: Inconsistent XP or level values can produce progression errors after editing.
health.item_fixes: Review hints and proposed fixes before applying any automated repair step.

backup.title: Auto Backup & Restore
backup.item_snapshots: Automatic snapshots can be created before write operations.
backup.item_restore: Restore workflows allow returning to a previous save state when needed.
backup.item_diff: If a diff preview is available, inspect it before restoring or overwriting data.
backup.item_why: Backups matter because save edits can affect progression, references and game stability.

logging.title: Logging & Error Reports
logging.item_reports: User-facing error reports should explain what failed in a readable way.
logging.item_copy: Use Copy Report when you need to share diagnostic output quickly.
logging.item_export: Use Export Logs when a longer support or debugging trail is required.
logging.item_levels: When both are available, user logs focus on workflows while developer logs include deeper technical traces.

updates.title: Updates
updates.item_check: Check for updates from inside the app when update functionality is available.
updates.item_download: Download the update package before installation starts.
updates.item_install: Install updates with the built-in flow instead of replacing files manually.
updates.item_relaunch: Relaunch the app after installation if prompted.
updates.item_progress: Use the progress display to monitor download and install status.

accessibility.title: Accessibility / Controls
accessibility.item_keyboard: Most core actions should remain reachable with keyboard navigation.
accessibility.item_focus: Visible focus states make navigation and active controls easier to track.
accessibility.item_contrast: Readable contrast helps when working for long sessions in dark UI themes.
accessibility.item_help: The help button keeps this wiki reachable at any time inside the app.
